snippet.title: Zombie Cure Lab | Console Edition | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Zombie Cure Lab will be released on 27th May on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S! 
----
Construct a laboratory base full of machinery to cure zombies. Assign workers to gather and process resources, building up your economy. Defend against zombie attacks and convert them into your workforce. Research technologies to develop the final antidote and restore humanity.

Join the mission to save humanity – soon also on console!
https://zombiecurelab.aerosoft.com/
